- Ensure all doors are securely closed -> lockDoors with unlock false and door array includes driver passenger rear_left rear_right presumably all four doors
- Engage parking brake -> activateParkingBrake engage

But we have no direct function to fill fuel tank with gallons. There's fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount in gallons. So we would call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 43.85.

Thus sequence: startEngine, lockDoors, activateParkingBrake, fillFuelTank.

Let's produce calls accordingly. We'll use separate calls sequentially.
